(Published by Authority)PART I : SECTION (I) — GENERALGovernment Notifications
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 41 (3) read with Section 51 of the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, I, MangalaSamaraweera, Minister of Finance and Mass Media, do by this Order prescribe the following regulations.
MANGALA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Finance and Mass Media.Ministry of Finance and Mass Media,Colombo 01,11th January, 2019.
1. These regulations may be cited as the Finance (Carbon Tax) Regulations, No. 1 of 2019.

2. The Carbon Tax (hereinafter referret to as ‘‘ the tax’’), shall be paid by the registered owner of any relevant Motorvehicle and collected by the Divisional Secretary in accordance with the Part XI of the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018. If therenewal of annual registration of the motor vehicle is done by Provincial Commisioner of Motor Traffic, the tax shall becollected by such Commissioners at the time of renewal of annual registration of the motor vehicle.

In the case of online renewal of annual registration of moter vehicle, the tax shall be paid by the registeredowner of the relevant moter vehicle separately to the Divisional Secretary or Provincial Commissioner of Motor Trafficas the case may be.

3. Any Divisional Secretary or Provincial Commissioner of Motor Traffic who collects the tax, as the case may be,shall remit the amounts collected in any month as per the paragraph 2 above, to the credit of the Consolidated Fund, on orbefore 10th day of the following month.

4. Any Divisional Secretary or Provincial Commissioner of Motor Traffic shall submit a monthly statement ofrevenue on the tax collected and remitted to the Consolidated Fund to the Commissioner General of Motor Traffic.
